description: A React component for the admin console's database settings page in Mattermost, including configuration options, database connection recycling, and search backend info.

classes.name: DatabaseSettings
classes.description: React component managing the database settings in the admin console, including configuration retrieval, rendering, and database connection recycling.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Constructs and returns the AdminConfig object based on the current component state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the current search backend info after component mounts.

methods.name: getSearchBackend
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the active search backend.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state from the provided AdminConfig object.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of the settings page.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the database settings form, including connection info, configuration options, and recycle button.
